oneLine: Advent Hotels International completes the purchase of the final stake in BD&P Hotels.

sources.title: Advent Hotels International Completes Purchase of Final 25% Stake in BD&P Hotels

synopsis: Advent Hotels International Limited has approved and executed a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire the remaining 25% equity stake in BD&P Hotels (India) Private Limited. Through this transaction, BD&P Hotels transitions from a 75% owned entity into a 100% wholly owned subsidiary, giving Advent Hotels full control over operational and strategic execution and removing non-controlling interest leakage. BD&P Hotels reported a revenue from operations of ₹102.37 crore for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, and holds a paid-up share capital of ₹39.31 crore. The article does not name the specific selling shareholders or disclose the monetary deal value for the 25% stake.
